name: ambiguous
description: Vague request. Shows: clarifying questions instead of guessing, compliance policy overriding a human answer (raw IPs) with agent self-correction, then a mid-run requirement change that invalidates exactly the affected stages, adds a new stage, and re-requests approvals.

script.requirement: Make links safer by blocking links to other URL shorteners, and let links expire after an optional expiry time (expired links answer 410). Keep visitor analytics privacy-safe.
